data.one_liner: Generates Dart code that embeds arbitrary file contents as literals.
data.what_it_does: The package reads non‑Dart files at build time and creates Dart constants (strings, binary, or structured records) containing their contents. It updates the generated code whenever the source files change.
use_when: You need compile‑time access to configuration files, test fixtures, or other assets without runtime I/O.
You want type‑safe access to embedded structured data like YAML, JSON, or TOML.
avoid_when: You require dynamic loading of files at runtime.
The project targets platforms where build_runner is unavailable or undesirable.
strengths: Eliminates runtime file I/O and async handling
Supports multiple formats (text, binary, YAML, JSON, TOML)
Works with Dart records for structured data
weaknesses: Requires build_runner and code generation step
Only works for compile‑time known files
data.setup_notes: Add embed_annotation, embed, and build_runner as dev dependencies; run build_runner to generate code.
